title: HIPAA Access Control
text: Role-based access control must limit PHI to job-required minimum. Quarterly reviews are mandatory for privileged accounts. Emergency break-glass access must be logged and reviewed within 24 hours. Contractors require separate tenant isolation.

title: RAG Chunking Strategies
text: Fixed-size chunking splits text by token or word count with overlap between windows. Overlap preserves continuity when facts span chunk boundaries. Sentence chunking respects linguistic boundaries and avoids mid-sentence cuts. Recursive hierarchical chunking uses paragraph, line, and sentence separators in priority order. Semantic breakpoint chunking detects topic shifts via embedding distance between adjacent segments.

title: Contextual Retrieval
text: Contextual retrieval prepends document metadata and a short summary to every chunk before embedding. Isolated chunks remain interpretable when retrieved alone. This pattern is recommended for policy libraries and compliance corpora. Pair contextual chunking with citation metadata in the vector database.

title: Vector Database Design
text: Vector databases store dense embeddings with metadata filters for category and version. Chroma supports persistent local collections per RAG experiment. Hybrid retrieval adds BM25 sparse scores fused with vector ranks using reciprocal rank fusion. Store chunking_method in metadata to debug retrieval quality.

title: SOC Incident Response
text: Correlate SIEM alerts with asset criticality before escalation. Ransomware patterns require network isolation within 15 minutes. Bulk PHI export attempts trigger mandatory legal notification workflows. Preserve forensic images before system recovery.

title: Local LLM Fine-Tuning
text: LoRA trains low-rank adapters on frozen base weights. QLoRA combines 4-bit quantization with LoRA for consumer GPUs. Full fine-tuning updates all parameters and needs more VRAM. Always version datasets and evaluation prompts before deployment.
